scope.description: One configuration change attempted by a stable leader whose durable log write for that configuration entry fails.
assumptions: configurationChangeChIfStable has admitted the request (latest==committed and the leader has committed an entry of its term)
the only faulted component is the LogStore's StoreLogs call
excluded: consequences that require the node to regain leadership and commit the phantom configuration
failures of StableStore, the transport or the snapshot store

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: A LogStore wrapper fails exactly one StoreLogs call; no target source is replaced
election/heartbeat/lease timeouts are shortened and the log level is raised to ERROR so the single-voter election completes quickly
the harness reads the Raft instance's latest/committed configuration after the injected failure

plan_uncertainties: The unit observes one injected failure on one single-voter leader; a different store failure point (for example inside a follower's log append) is a separate scenario.
grounding_unresolved: Whether the divergence can be turned into a committed configuration by a later leadership change
Whether a node that later regains leadership actually commits the phantom configuration is not exercised by this unit.

boundaries: consequences that require the node to regain leadership and commit the phantom configuration
